sname: トラブル・ハプニング
title: トラブル時のとっさのひと言

items.en: Hey, Alex, the car just died. Can you come get us?
items.jp: ねえアレックス、車が急に止まった。迎えに来られる？
items.speak: Hey, Alex, the car just died. Can you come get us?

items.en: I dunno where we are. The map stopped loading a few blocks back.
items.jp: 今どこにいるのか分からない。数ブロック前から地図が読み込めなくなった。
items.speak: I dunno where we are. The map stopped loading a few blocks back.
items.note: 元の形: do not know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:場所が分からない時

items.en: Could you say that again? The alarm's drowning you out.
items.jp: もう一度言ってもらえますか？警報音で聞こえません。
items.speak: Could you say that again? The alarm's drowning you out.

items.en: Maya, don't touch the switch. There's water near the outlet.
items.jp: マヤ、スイッチに触らないで。コンセントの近くに水がある。
items.speak: Maya, don't touch the switch. There's water near the outlet.

items.en: The last bus left five minutes ago. What do we do now?
items.jp: 最終バスは5分前に出たよ。これからどうする？
items.speak: The last bus left five minutes ago. What do we do now?

items.en: Hey, folks, does anybody know if the road is still closed?
items.jp: すみません、道路がまだ通行止めか分かる方いますか？
items.speak: Hey, folks, does anybody know if the road is still closed?

items.en: I got locked out. My keys are on the table inside.
items.jp: 締め出されちゃった。鍵は部屋の中のテーブルにある。
items.speak: I got locked out. My keys are on the table inside.

items.en: Dude, the ceiling's leaking. Grab a bucket before it hits the floor.
items.jp: ねえ、天井から水が漏れてる。床に落ちる前にバケツを持ってきて。
items.speak: Dude, the ceiling's leaking. Grab a bucket before it hits the floor.

items.en: I'm kinda lost. Is the visitor center this way?
items.jp: ちょっと道に迷ってしまって。ビジターセンターはこの方向ですか？
items.speak: I'm kinda lost. Is the visitor center this way?
items.note: 元の形: kind of／聞こえ方: カインダ／使う場面:控えめに困り事を伝える

items.en: Hey, Jen, my phone's dead. Can I borrow yours for a minute?
items.jp: ねえジェン、スマホの充電が切れた。少し借りてもいい？
items.speak: Hey, Jen, my phone's dead. Can I borrow yours for a minute?

items.en: No idea. Let's ask someone who works here.
items.jp: 分からないな。ここで働いてる人に聞こう。
items.speak: No idea. Let's ask someone who works here.

items.en: Beats me. The sign was covered up when we got here.
items.jp: さあね。着いた時には標識が隠れてたんだ。
items.speak: Beats me. The sign was covered up when we got here.

items.en: Your guess is as good as mine. The whole block's dark.
items.jp: 私にも見当がつかないよ。この一帯が全部真っ暗だ。
items.speak: Your guess is as good as mine. The whole block's dark.

items.en: I couldn't tell you. I just got here myself.
items.jp: 何とも言えないな。私も今着いたところだから。
items.speak: I couldn't tell you. I just got here myself.

items.en: Hey, Sam, didja see which way the ambulance went?
items.jp: ねえサム、救急車がどっちへ行ったか見た？
items.speak: Hey, Sam, didja see which way the ambulance went?
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:親しい相手への確認

items.en: The airline lost my bag, and my medication's inside.
items.jp: 航空会社に荷物をなくされて、中に薬が入ってるんです。
items.speak: The airline lost my bag, and my medication's inside.

items.en: Excuse me, I think this is the wrong gate. Could you check?
items.jp: すみません、搭乗口を間違えたかもしれません。確認してもらえますか？
items.speak: Excuse me, I think this is the wrong gate. Could you check?

items.en: Hey, buddy, you good? You look a little shaken up.
items.jp: ねえ、大丈夫？少し動揺してるみたいだけど。
items.speak: Hey, buddy, you good? You look a little shaken up.
items.note: 元の形: are you good／聞こえ方: ユーグッ／使う場面:親しい相手を気遣う

items.en: I'm fine, just rattled. Give me a second to catch my breath.
items.jp: 大丈夫、ちょっとびっくりしただけ。息を整えるから少し待って。
items.speak: I'm fine, just rattled. Give me a second to catch my breath.

items.en: C'mon, the service desk is about to close. Let's go now.
items.jp: ほら、案内窓口が閉まりそうだ。今行こう。
items.speak: C'mon, the service desk is about to close. Let's go now.
items.note: 元の形: come on／聞こえ方: カモン／使う場面:相手を急かす

items.en: The elevator stopped between floors. We're stuck in here.
items.jp: エレベーターが階の間で止まった。閉じ込められてる。
items.speak: The elevator stopped between floors. We're stuck in here.

items.en: Don't panic. I already called building security.
items.jp: 慌てないで。もうビルの警備に電話したよ。
items.speak: Don't panic. I already called building security.

items.en: Hey, Mia, the reservation's for tomorrow, not tonight.
items.jp: ねえミア、予約は今夜じゃなくて明日になってる。
items.speak: Hey, Mia, the reservation's for tomorrow, not tonight.

items.en: You're kidding. I booked it for the twenty-third.
items.jp: うそでしょ。23日で予約したのに。
items.speak: You're kidding. I booked it for the twenty-third.

items.en: I've gotta call the school before they close.
items.jp: 学校が閉まる前に電話しなきゃ。
items.speak: I've gotta call the school before they close.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: アイヴガラ／使う場面:急ぐ必要を伝える

items.en: Hey, Nora, can you stay on the line while I find the address?
items.jp: ねえノラ、住所を探す間、電話をつないだままでいてくれる？
items.speak: Hey, Nora, can you stay on the line while I find the address?

items.en: I dunno how long the battery will last, so let's be quick.
items.jp: 電池がどれくらいもつか分からないから、手短にしよう。
items.speak: I dunno how long the battery will last, so let's be quick.
items.note: 元の形: do not know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:時間を急ぐ時

items.en: Could you help me figure out where this street is?
items.jp: この通りがどこなのか、一緒に調べてもらえますか？
items.speak: Could you help me figure out where this street is?

items.en: Lemme see the confirmation email. The address might be in there.
items.jp: 確認メールを見せて。住所が載ってるかもしれない。
items.speak: Lemme see the confirmation email. The address might be in there.
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:確認を申し出る

items.en: Hey, Chris, don't force the door. It might jam worse.
items.jp: ねえクリス、ドアを無理に開けないで。もっと壊れるかもしれない。
items.speak: Hey, Chris, don't force the door. It might jam worse.

items.en: The water's coming in under the door. We should move our bags.
items.jp: ドアの下から水が入ってきてる。荷物を移動させよう。
items.speak: The water's coming in under the door. We should move our bags.

items.en: I'm gonna call the front desk and ask for another room.
items.jp: フロントに電話して、別の部屋を頼むね。
items.speak: I'm gonna call the front desk and ask for another room.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:これからの行動を伝える

items.en: Hey, folks, is there a safe place to wait out this storm?
items.jp: すみません、この嵐をやり過ごせる安全な場所はありますか？
items.speak: Hey, folks, is there a safe place to wait out this storm?

items.en: The road's blocked. We gotta turn around and take the highway.
items.jp: 道路が塞がってる。引き返して高速道路を使わないと。
items.speak: The road's blocked. We gotta turn around and take the highway.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:必要な対応を伝える

items.en: We can try the side street, but I can't promise it's open.
items.jp: 脇道を試せるけど、通れるとは約束できないよ。
items.speak: We can try the side street, but I can't promise it's open.

items.en: Hey, babe, the train's delayed. I'm not sure when I'll get home.
items.jp: ねえ、電車が遅れてる。いつ帰れるか分からない。
items.speak: Hey, babe, the train's delayed. I'm not sure when I'll get home.

items.en: No worries. Text me when you know, and I'll keep dinner warm.
items.jp: 大丈夫。分かったら連絡して。夕飯は温めておくよ。
items.speak: No worries. Text me when you know, and I'll keep dinner warm.

items.en: Wait, what? You left your passport in the taxi?
items.jp: え、何だって？パスポートをタクシーに置いてきたの？
items.speak: Wait, what? You left your passport in the taxi?

items.en: I know. I'm calling the taxi company right now.
items.jp: 分かってる。今すぐタクシー会社に電話してる。
items.speak: I know. I'm calling the taxi company right now.

items.en: Hey, boss, the delivery never showed up. Should I reorder it?
items.jp: すみません、荷物が届きませんでした。再注文しましょうか？
items.speak: Hey, boss, the delivery never showed up. Should I reorder it?

items.en: Check the tracking page first. It might've gone to the wrong building.
items.jp: まず追跡ページを確認して。別の建物に届いたのかもしれない。
items.speak: Check the tracking page first. It might've gone to the wrong building.

items.en: This isn't what I ordered. Could you check the receipt with me?
items.jp: 注文したものと違います。レシートを一緒に確認していただけますか？
items.speak: This isn't what I ordered. Could you check the receipt with me?

items.en: I'm sorry, ma'am. I'll fix it right away.
items.jp: 申し訳ございません。すぐに対応いたします。
items.speak: I'm sorry, ma'am. I'll fix it right away.

items.en: Hey, man, I think your backpack's still on the bench.
items.jp: ねえ、リュックがまだベンチにあるみたいだよ。
items.speak: Hey, man, I think your backpack's still on the bench.

items.en: Oh, wow. Thanks for catching that. I would've missed it.
items.jp: ああ、よかった。気づいてくれてありがとう。見落とすところだった。
items.speak: Oh, wow. Thanks for catching that. I would've missed it.

items.en: Can you hold this for me while I talk to the driver?
items.jp: 運転手さんと話す間、これを持っていてくれますか？
items.speak: Can you hold this for me while I talk to the driver?

items.en: Sure thing. Take your time; we're not in a rush.
items.jp: もちろん。急がなくていいよ。時間はあるから。
items.speak: Sure thing. Take your time; we're not in a rush.

items.en: Could you write that down? I don't wanna mix up the room number.
items.jp: 部屋番号を間違えたくないので、書いてもらえますか？
items.speak: Could you write that down? I don't wanna mix up the room number.
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:間違いを避けたい時

items.en: Long story short, the key was in my other coat the whole time.
items.jp: 手短に言うと、鍵はずっと別のコートに入ってた。
items.speak: Long story short, the key was in my other coat the whole time.

items.en: Okay, one thing at a time. What's the first thing we need to do?
items.jp: よし、一つずつ。まず何をすればいい？
items.speak: Okay, one thing at a time. What's the first thing we need to do?
